title: Almost plurinodal alteration of the first term of a proper hypercover
statement: Let $S$ and $X$ be integral excellent Noetherian schemes of finite dimension, and let $f:X\to S$ be proper dominant [def-weil-proper-morphism]. There exist an integral excellent Noetherian scheme $T$, an alteration $a:T\to S$, and an augmented proper hypercover $\epsilon:Y_\bullet\to X\times_S T$ such that $Y_0\to T$ is an almost plurinodal datum in the sense of [def-trf-orgogozo-induction-data]. Here proper hypercover means that the augmentation in degree zero and all simplicial matching maps are proper surjective. Each $Y_i$ is finite type over $T$, so has a finite bound on its fibre dimensions. Each curve factor of each plurinodal summand comes with a closed subscheme finite over its base containing its nonsmooth locus, as required by the tower data. The semistable tower summands of $Y_0\to T$ have relative dimension equal to the dimension of the generic fibre of $f$; the other summand has nowhere dense image. One may take $\dim T=\dim S$.

source.place: Proposition 3.3.1 and Lemma 3.3.2, pp. 9--10, from de Jong plurinodal alterations. This is an existence statement for the hypercover, not a nearby-cycle theorem. Local archival PDF WANTED; author PDF read online.
